title: whatsapp_inbox._quota.set
description: Mirror of `schemas/quota_set.json` in ERPlora/whatsapp_inbox AFTER whatsapp_inbox#155: the meter takes the spend from the platform as well as the cap. `monthly_usage` is optional on purpose — the cap must keep arriving on a tick where the platform did not report a usable spend.

monthly_limit.description: Billable messages per calendar month the plan allows. 0 = no cap.

monthly_usage.description: Billable messages already spent this calendar month, as the platform counts them. Absent = the platform did not say; the meter keeps whatever it had.
